title: APT Supports RFDS Victoria Gala to Help Raise Over $200,000 for Vital Regional Healthcare
author: Alice
body:
5 June 2025

APT Luxury Travel was proud to return as Principal Event Sponsor for the Royal Flying Doctor Service (RFDS) Victoria Gala Dinner last week, Wednesday 4 June. The ‘Going the Distance’ Gala dinner event raised more than $200,000 for vital healthcare services across rural and remote parts of the state.

The evening, hosted by Nat Edwards and attended by MPs, donors, and partners of RFDS, featured powerful stories, performances and a high-energy live auction. APT Travel Group also contributed one of the night’s most impactful fundraising items: a Travelmarvel Kimberley Coastal Cruise, which raised an incredible $27,000 under the hammer—one of the top results of the night.

Lorna Heyward, COO of APT Travel Group, attended the event with members of the APT team, said, “We’re proud to continue our support of RFDS Victoria and their vital work across the state. As a business deeply connected to Australia’s regional heartlands, we understand the importance of accessible, high-quality care—no matter how remote the location.”

APT’s continued partnership with RFDS Victoria is part of a broader commitment to giving back to the communities that form the backdrop to so many of its touring and cruising journeys. With roots in regional Australia, APT’s alignment with the RFDS mission is a natural fit, underpinned by shared values of service, care and connection.
The funds raised on the night will go directly toward the delivery of critical healthcare to remote Victorians, supporting RFDS Victoria’s mobile patient services, mental health outreach, and chronic condition programs.
